title: Tim Cook's final earnings call as Apple CEO
summary: Tim Cook delivered his final earnings call as Apple's (AAPL) CEO before passing the baton to incoming CEO John Ternus.

title: Tech stocks today: Microsoft makes market history, Apple and Amazon beat on earnings
summary: Tech stocks climbed higher on Thursday, as Microsoft posted strong earnings results.

title: Chip stocks are rebounding — except for Qualcomm: Why it might just be a 'one off'
summary: Chip stocks are rebounding on Thursday, with the exception of Qualcomm (QCOM), which provided profit guidance that disappointed Wall Street. BD8 Capital Partners CEO and CIO Barbara Doran and Yahoo Finance Technology Editor Dan Howley chat with Morning Brief host Julie Hyman about Qualcomm and the larger chip sector.

title: Dow Jones Futures: Apple, Amazon Diverge Late; What To Do After AI Stocks Surge
summary: The stock market jumped Thursday as Microsoft powered a big AI rebound. Apple and Amazon led earnings late.

title: Apple tops estimates in CEO Cook's final quarter, but shares fall
summary: Apple beat market expectations in its latest results on Thursday, capping Tim Cook's final earnings report as CEO with a strong showing, although the outlook for the current quarter disappointed investors.Apple touched a $5 trillion market value this week, while some rivals have seen their shares punished as investors question the profitability of their huge AI bets.

title: Apple Slides After Supply Shortages Hurts Sales Forecast
summary: Apple stocks tumbled in late trading after component shortages weighed on the company's sales forecast, signaling that industrywide supply constraints are taking a bigger toll than anticipated. It also gave a forecast that is weaker than expected, further hurting the stock in the after market. Bloomberg News Managing Editor for Global Consumer Tech Mark Gurman reacts to the mixed earnings report. title: Apple Stock Down 6% as Earnings Call Ends
summary: Apple stock was sharply lower Thursday evening as the iPhone maker wrapped up its fiscal third-quarter earnings call . Apple reported stronger-than-expected earnings results for its June quarter. But Wall Street was more focused on the company's financial outlook, which missed estimates.

title: Tim Cook says Apple may charge for AI Siri
summary: Apple hinted Thursday that heavy users of its revamped Siri may have to pay for access.

title: Apple Says It Raised Mac Prices 'Reluctantly'
summary: During the company's earnings call Thursday, CEO Tim Cook shed some light about Apple's decision to raise prices on Macs and iPads.  Apple had lifted prices on some products earlier this year to offset some of the cost concerns as memory prices surged.  Cook said on the call that Apple made this decision "reluctantly."

title: Apple Sales Exceed $109 Billion, but Revenue Guidance Disappoints
summary: The company is set to release an upgraded Siri assistant in the fall, and it continues to contend with higher component costs.
